description: Answer the open clarification on a story (the counterpart to request_input). Records the answer + answeredAt + answerer and flips the awaiting_input status to 'answered'; emits a story.input_provided audit event. Does NOT move the lane — an answer isn't always an unblock ("no, do X" changes the work), so resuming stays a human/agent decision.

answer.description: The answer to the open question. Records answeredAt + the answerer and flips status to 'answered'. Does NOT move the lane — resuming the work stays a human/agent decision.

storyId.description: UUID of the story whose open clarification is being answered.

name: resolve_input
